sidecar.transformer_description: Inverse of Hong Kong 1980 to WGS 84 (1) + Hong Kong 1980 Grid (with axis order normalized for visualization)

native_lattice.method: guillotine search; minimize residual area, then part count

domain.hardware: Mac arm64 macOS15.7.4, 10 logical CPUs, 24 GiB, local HFS disk
domain.caveat: local mostly-valid tiles; new terrain/NoData distributions and media uncalibrated

methodology.direction: full native union-task wall divided by missing native directions
methodology.frame: matched warm complete run minus fixed startup/catalog, divided by native frames
methodology.efficiency: one/two-worker matched warm work after fixed costs; capped at 1
methodology.startup_catalog: fixed engineering allowance checked against phase/whole-run timings
methodology.excluded: planning/submission and OS-cache flush; run API includes final verification
methodology.memory_disk: conservative V1 allocation and uncompressed bytes plus temporary/metadata headroom
methodology.uncalibrated_terms: media, final hits and four-worker costs are provisional
methodology.component_revision: Separate measured directional and output concurrency; classification split from frame cost. Derived only from calibration, before any hold-out outcomes.

estimate.range_note: engineering variation allowance, not a fitted confidence interval
assumptions: local same-machine filesystem; warm OS/JIT code cache
cold means empty directional cache, not flushed OS cache
outputs include lossless compression/readback; media separate
whole-territory estimates require explicit profile and are extrapolations

limitations: Footprints do not establish valid DSM or complete sunward support
1 km cutoff does not bound unseen farther terrain
Solar model and tile references are approximations
